name: matcha
description: Root dev orchestration for the Matcha project: Backend (Express + TypeScript) and Frontend (React + Vite) are separate npm projects.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue.bold,magenta.bold -p '{time} {name}' -t HH:mm:ss --pad-prefix --kill-others-on-fail 'npm --prefix Backend run dev' 'npm --prefix Frontend run dev'
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:db && npm run dev
